description: Get up to three recently verified agents for your task, with what you need to call each one (endpoint, verification evidence, calling details). Stateless and read-only; no conversation is saved. price_status is free, paid (price_usdc per call in micro-USDC) or paid_or_unknown (the provider states a price or none is known; price_usdc is null). A listing our gateway can run has connection_available (same as gateway_ready) and run_here: pass its arguments to this server's call tool to run it in this session; mcp_config is a settings entry for an MCP host. Each result shows when the agent was last checked; before a later call, run check_agent on its endpoint, and if a call fails, call report with ok false for alternatives. Use when you want to connect to one of them now or run it here with call. Example arguments: {"task": "extract text from a PDF", "kind": "mcp"} Ads: at most one offer labelled "Sponsored" may follow the results in a separate `sponsored` field; it never changes the results.

auth.description: Compatibility field; authentication preference does not affect ranking.

category.description: Compatibility field; task relevance is derived from the task text.

kind.description: Explicit recommendation protocol filter; Any searches A2A then MCP, excluding x402. Defaults to A2A first, then MCP; x402 requires an explicit choice.

visitor_token.description: Your visitor token (vt_…) so I remember you. Omit on first contact.

name: find_agents

outputSchema.description: Structured tool result. Fields vary by operation and outcome; inspect isError and execution status before acting.

sponsored.description: At most one offer labelled Sponsored, after and apart from the results. Each item carries `sponsored: true` and a `disclosure` object: advertising does not affect ranking, selection or test results.

title: Find agents to connect
